subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.F.------PROG.SIGN.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 210 (WAC-8). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) is the partner. The title names EXT-F (extended functionalism); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and TRS (transition). From ALT-F: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: ALT-F-2 (alternative functionalism) and INFO-DS (information dissemination). From ALT-F-2: PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: AFTD (affinity tendencies).
